not_for: Freelancers (unless applying for long-term contract roles)
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Those without a finalized resume should take Resume Building first.

prerequisites.required: A defined target role or industry.

system_requirements.hardware: A computer with a webcam and microphone for mock interviews.

overview.positioning: Transform interview anxiety into confidence through structured preparation and proven behavioral frameworks.
overview.short_description: Master the art of interviewing, from the initial HR screen to the final executive round.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Deliver a compelling 'Tell me about yourself' elevator pitch.
Answer complex behavioral questions using the STAR method.
Navigate difficult questions regarding employment gaps or weaknesses.
Conduct structured follow-ups that leave a lasting impression.

why_now.industry_shift: Interviews have largely shifted to remote video formats, requiring new techniques for building rapport.
why_now.ai_impact: Some initial screening is now done via automated asynchronous video interviews (e.g., HireVue).
why_now.business_demand: Employers are placing higher emphasis on cultural fit and behavioral competencies over pure technical skills.
why_now.career_opportunity: Strong interview skills directly correlate with higher starting salaries and better job placements.

learning_outcomes: STRUCTURE concise and impactful responses to common interview questions.
DEMONSTRATE problem-solving skills through behavioral storytelling.
EVALUATE company culture and role alignment by asking strategic questions.
PERFORM confidently in both live video and asynchronous interview formats.

stages.focus: The elevator pitch and interview mindset.
Handling difficult questions and video dynamics.

core_tools.what_student_learns: Self-review of body language and tone.

stages.name: HR Screen
stages.desc: Brief phone call confirming basic qualifications and salary expectations.

stages.name: Hiring Manager
stages.desc: Deep dive into experience, cultural fit, and specific role requirements.

stages.name: Panel/Technical
stages.desc: Assessing hard skills or team dynamics with multiple stakeholders.

stages.name: Executive Round
stages.desc: Final alignment check with senior leadership.

business_use_cases.business_problem: Getting interviews but failing to receive offers.

ai_integration.ai_can_assist_with: Generating role-specific mock questions, analyzing speech patterns.
ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: Authentic enthusiasm and genuine human connection.
ai_integration.human_expertise_required: Reading the interviewer's body language and adjusting tone.
ai_integration.validation_protocol: Human review of recorded mock interviews.
ai_integration.responsible_use: Do not read AI-generated scripts verbatim during live interviews.

best_practices: Always research the company and the specific interviewers beforehand.
Have 5 core STAR stories prepared that can be adapted to multiple questions.
Look at the camera, not the screen, during video interviews.
Send a personalized thank-you note within 24 hours.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Nervousness and lack of structured preparation.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Using the STAR method to keep answers concise (under 2 minutes).

entry_roles: N/A - Skill applies to all roles
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: The ability to confidently navigate high-pressure conversations.

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Intake -> Live Mock Interview -> Detailed Feedback Session
freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: Testimonials from clients who landed jobs.

what_you_will_build: A customized 'Tell me about yourself' pitch.
A library of 5 versatile STAR stories.
A prepared list of questions to ask employers.

assessment.criteria: Clarity of answers, body language, and effective use of the STAR framework.

not_covered: Highly specific technical coding challenges (e.g., LeetCode).

faq.question: How do I prepare for a video interview versus in-person?
faq.answer: We cover specific techniques for video, including lighting, camera angle, and digital eye contact.

faq.question: What if I don't have experience for a behavioral question?
faq.answer: We teach you how to draw from academic, volunteer, or parallel experiences to answer effectively.

faq.question: How do I answer 'What is your biggest weakness?'
faq.answer: You will learn the framework for providing a genuine weakness along with the actionable steps you are taking to overcome it.
